Shed FAQs

Questions? Answers.

### What is Shed?

Shed is a telehealth clinic offering personalized treatment for weight loss, hair health, sexual wellness, and longevity. Our goal is to make getting care simple and convenient, with licensed medical providers, personalized treatment plans, and ongoing support to help you feel like the real you.

### How do I get started with Shed?

Getting started is simple. Fill out a short online health assessment and a licensed provider will review your information. If you’re eligible for treatment and prescribed medication, your prescription will be shipped directly to your door.

No waiting rooms. No complicated process.

### Do I meet with a doctor?

It depends on your state and treatment. In some cases, you’ll meet virtually with a licensed medical provider. In others, your provider may be able to review your online health assessment without a live appointment.

Either way, your treatment is reviewed and prescribed by a licensed provider, and you can reach out to your care team when you need support.

### What makes Shed different?

Shed gives you more than a prescription. Depending on your plan, you’ll have access to tools and support designed to help you get results and maintain them.

For our GLP-1 programs, that includes:

- Flat pricing that doesn’t increase with your dose
- Health coaching included with your plan
- Nutrition and exercise resources
- Ongoing access to your care team
- Free shipping on your medication

### Will my GLP-1 price increase if my dose increases?

No. With Shed GLP-1 plans, your price stays the same even if your provider increases your dose. No surprise price increases as your treatment progresses.

### What is included with Shed Health Coaching?

Your Shed Health Coach is there to help you build habits that work alongside your treatment. You can meet with your Coach as needed and get personalized help with:

- Nutrition
- Exercise and movement
- Sleep
- Stress
- Healthy habits
- Staying consistent with your goals

Plus, you’ll have access to resources you can use between coaching sessions.

‍ **Shed members who work with a Health Coach report losing 34% more weight than members who don’t.¹**

**‍** _¹Based on self-reported weight-loss data from Shed members who participated in Health Coaching compared with Shed members who did not. Individual results vary._

### Is shipping free?

Yes. Standard shipping is included at no additional cost.

### What states does Shed serve?

Shed offers telehealth services in all 50 states. Treatment availability may vary by state based on medical and regulatory requirements.

### Do I need insurance to use Shed?

No. You don’t need health insurance to use Shed. Our programs are designed to make pricing straightforward without going through insurance.

You can also use an eligible HSA or FSA card to pay for qualifying Shed treatments and services.

### Can I pay for Shed with my HSA or FSA?

Yes. Eligible Shed treatments and services can be paid for using HSA or FSA funds. Eligibility can depend on your plan and the treatment you receive.

### What if I need help during my treatment?

Getting support is easy. Through your Shed member portal, you can access your care team and resources in one place. Depending on what you need, you can:

- Meet with a Health Coach
- Connect with your medical provider
- Get support from the nursing team
- Access treatment and wellness resources
- Message our support team for help with your account or orders
